# Filament Nord Theme

Source: https://github.com/andreia/filament-nord-theme/blob/3.x/README.md


![GitHub Code Style Action Status](https://github.com/andreia/filament-nord-theme/actions/workflows/fix-php-code-style-issues.yml/badge.svg)

# Filament Nord Theme

A light and dark arctic Nord theme for Filament PHP.

![Dashboard Light and Dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreia/filament-nord-theme/main/docs/dashboard.jpg)

## Version Compatibility

 Filament | Filament Nord Theme | Documentation
:--------|:-------------------|:--------------
3.x      | 1.x                | [Check the docs](https://github.com/andreia/filament-nord-theme/tree/1.x)
4.x      | 2.x                | [Check the docs](https://github.com/andreia/filament-nord-theme/tree/2.x)
5.x      | 3.x                | Current

## Installation

```bash
composer require andreia/filament-nord-theme:"^3.0"
```

Register the plugin on your panel (e.g. `/app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php`):

```php
use Andreia\FilamentNordTheme\FilamentNordThemePlugin;

$panel
  ->plugin(FilamentNordThemePlugin::make())
```

Publish the theme assets:

```bash
php artisan filament:assets
```

Also add the line to import the Nord theme on your custom Filament`theme.css` (eg. `resources/css/filament/admin/theme.css`):
 
```js
 @import '../../../../vendor/filament/filament/resources/css/theme.css';
 @import '../../../../vendor/andreia/filament-nord-theme/resources/css/theme.css';
```

and run:

```bash
npm run build
```

You're all set!
